北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天晴但体感 -13℃，记得添衣保暖，别冻着啦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like -13℃. Remember to dress warmly and stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾又降温，体感 -4℃，出行小心慢行，注意安全。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and cold, feels like -4℃. Drive carefully and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 -3℃，注意添衣防寒，小心别感冒了。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like -3℃. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天 11℃，体感舒适，记得带伞以防小雨哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy at 11℃, quite comfortable. Bring an umbrella just in case!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 8℃ 略凉，风力较大，出门记得加件外套哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels a bit cool at 8℃ with moderate wind. Bring a jacket!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾弥漫，体感 -3℃，注意防寒，小心交通安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is very foggy and feels like -3℃. Stay warm and be careful on the roads.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾又降温，体感 -7℃，请注意保暖，小心驾驶。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy and very cold, feels like -7℃. Keep warm and drive safely.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，体感 4℃，湿冷侵袭，记得防潮保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with 100% humidity, feels like 4℃. It's damp and cool, stay warm!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，体感 -5℃，湿冷入骨，注意防寒，出行注意安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy and feels like -5℃. It's damp and bone-chilling cold, stay warm and safe.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴冷，体感 -4℃，注意防寒保暖，记得多喝水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but cold, feels like -4℃. Stay warm and remember to drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆起雾啦，体感 5℃ 湿润，出行注意慢行，带把伞备用。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 5℃ and humid. Drive slowly and bring an umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -29℃，请务必全副武装，注意防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -29℃. Bundle up completely to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -29℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳严寒，体感 -27℃，出门一定穿最厚的衣服，保重身体！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is severely cold, feels like -27℃. Wear your warmest clothes and take care!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 6℃，风力不大，早晚温差大，记得加衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels like 6℃. The temperature difference between morning and evening is big, remember to add layers!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 3℃ 略冷，海风阵阵，出门别忘了加外套。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels a bit cold at 3℃ with sea breezes. Don't forget your jacket!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -13℃，风力较大，注意防寒防风，别冻坏了。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like -13℃ with strong winds. Protect yourself from the cold and wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -16℃，寒风凛冽，出门务必严实保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -16℃ with a biting wind. Dress very warmly when going out!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃
